parts.name: Lower Translation Panel
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower sliding sash of the window, made primarily of glass with a supporting frame.
parts.Functional_description: It allows vertical movement to open or close the lower section of the window for ventilation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically within the window frame along guide tracks.

parts.name: Upper Translation Panel
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper sliding sash of the window, made of glass and supported by a frame.
parts.Functional_description: It can slide vertically to open or close the upper section of the window, though often remains fixed in many designs.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically within the window frame, opposite to the lower sash.

parts.name: Base Body (Window Frame)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the window, typically made of PVC or wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the sliding panels, ensuring smooth operation and sealing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed boundary for the moving panels.
